details.ingredients:
Makhana, Olive Oil, Peri Peri Spice Blend & Condiments [Red Chilli Powder, Dry Mango, Cumin, Dry Ginger, Pepper, Tomato Powder, Garlic Powder & Onion Powder], Iodised Salt, Mishri Powder and Potato Powder.
Allergen Information: Processed in a facility also handling Wheat, Sesame Seeds, Milk, Tree Nuts, Dried Fruits and Soy. May contain traces.

details.description: Experience the delicate, wholesome taste of Khetika Raw Makhana, a premium blend of carefully chosen spices designed to elevate the natural flavour of makhana (fox nuts). With a perfect balance of mild, aromatic, and slightly spicy notes, this masala adds a delicious crunch, vibrant colour, and rich taste to your healthy snacks. Ideal for everyday munching or special occasions, it delivers consistent, delightful flavour in every bite. Made from pure ingredients and free from artificial colours and preservatives, it ensures natural goodness—making your makhana snacks irresistibly tasty, nutritious, and satisfying.

Khetika Chia Seeds are a powerhouse of nutrition, naturally rich in omega-3 fatty acids, fibre and protein. These tiny seeds help support digestion, heart health and sustained energy throughout the day. Add them to smoothies, salads, yoghurt, cereals or desserts for a wholesome nutritional boost. Naturally raw and unprocessed, they contain no added preservatives or artificial additives, making them an excellent choice for daily wellness and a balanced, plant-based lifestyle.

Khetika Premium Flax Seeds are carefully sourced and packed to deliver quality and freshness. These versatile seeds have a mild, nutty flavour and can be easily incorporated into a variety of foods and beverages. Add them to smoothies, cereals, salads, baked goods, or everyday recipes for a convenient way to enjoy their unique texture and taste.
details.ingredients: Flax Seeds (Alsi)
details.usageInstructions:
Add to smoothies, shakes, and juices.
Sprinkle over breakfast cereals, oatmeal, yoghurt, or salads.
Mix into atta for rotis, parathas, and baked goods.
Blend into chutneys, trail mixes, or energy bars.
Consume lightly roasted or ground flax seeds for better nutrient absorption.
